newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields rise on one-month to one-year Saudi t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields rise on one-month to one-year Saudi t-bills.

text.p: Yields on one-month to one-year treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) rose, bankers said on Tuesday.

The yield on 28-day bills rose to 5.4850 percent from 5.4217 percent last week while the rate on 91-day climbed to 5.5472 percent from 5.48360 percent and the rate on 182-day rose to 5.6097 percent from 5.5444 percent.
The yield on one-year t-bills increased to 5.8341 percent from 5.5569 percent last week. They were priced at 99.57520, 98.61719, 97.24219 and 94.42969 respectively.
One-month rates were put at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, three months rates at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and six months rates at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
One-year interbank rates were quoted at six, 5-7/8 percent.
SAMA last week started to issue the bills on Tuesday rather than Monday. It has also slashed the amount to two billion riyals from three billion and began to offer one-year bills on a weekly basis.
